sections.introduction: Chandan Ark is a classical Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Safed Chandan (Santalum album), commonly known as White Sandalwood. This aromatic and cooling formulation is traditionally used for managing disorders associated with aggravated Pitta Dosha, excessive body heat, urinary irritation, burning sensation, and heat-induced weakness. In Ayurveda, White Sandalwood is regarded as one of the finest natural cooling herbs. Its fragrant heartwood possesses Sheeta Virya (cold potency) and acts as a soothing agent for the urinary system, blood, heart, and mind. Chandan Ark is prepared through the process of distillation, which captures the volatile therapeutic principles of sandalwood into a gentle aqueous extract. Because this formulation contains only sandalwood as the primary ingredient, it is considered more cooling and calming than many compound distillates. It is traditionally administered during summer seasons, burning urinary disorders, chronic Pitta aggravation, and conditions associated with internal heat.
sections.ingredients:
Main Ingredient 

 Safed Chandan (White Sandalwood) (Santalum album) – 2.5 seer (~2.3 kg)

 Fine wood powder or coarse shavings 


 Liquid Medium 

 Water – 20 seer (~18–19 liters) 


 Method of Preparation 
 The coarse powder or shavings of high-quality White Sandalwood are soaked overnight in approximately eight times water. This prolonged soaking softens the woody fibers and facilitates extraction of aromatic constituents. The following morning, the soaked mixture is transferred into a traditional Bhapka or Nadika Yantra (distillation apparatus). The preparation is then heated gently so that the volatile cooling compounds rise with steam and condense into distilled liquid. Approximately 20 bottles of aromatic distillate are collected and stored in clean glass containers. This distillation method preserves the subtle fragrance and therapeutic cooling principles of sandalwood without exposing it to excessive heat.

 Administered with thin milk lassi (buttermilk-like milk preparation)

sections.mode_of_action:
According to Ayurvedic principles, excessive heat in the body affects the Rakta Dhatu (blood tissue), urinary tract, digestive system, and mind. Chandan Ark helps reduce this aggravated heat through its cooling and soothing properties. 

 Its mild aromatic principles act upon: 

 The urinary tract 
 Circulatory system 
 Nervous system 
 Digestive fire aggravated by Pitta 

 The formulation helps maintain fluid balance and reduces internal irritation without producing heaviness. 

 Modern Perspective 
 Santalum album contains several aromatic compounds including: 

 Alpha-santalol 
 Beta-santalol 
 Volatile oils 
 Sesquiterpenes 

 These compounds are known for: 

 Cooling and soothing effects 
 Mild antimicrobial activity 
 Relaxing fragrance 
 Anti-inflammatory properties 

 Distilled sandalwood preparations have traditionally been valued for urinary comfort, skin cooling, and emotional calmness. 

 Advantages of Ark Preparation 
 The Ark (distillate) form offers several benefits: 

 Rapid absorption 
 Light digestion 
 Pleasant aroma 
 Easy administration 
 Cooling effect without heaviness 

 Unlike dense decoctions or oily preparations, Chandan Ark is gentle on digestion and suitable even in weak digestive states.
sections.precautions:
Excessive use in very cold constitution individuals should be avoided 
 Use cautiously in severe low digestive fire conditions 
 Store in a cool, airtight glass bottle 
 Always use clean and properly prepared distillate 


 Conclusion 
 Chandan Ark is a simple yet highly effective Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Santalum album (White Sandalwood). Its cooling, soothing, and Pitta-pacifying properties make it valuable in urinary irritation, burning sensation, excessive body heat, and blood-related Pitta disorders. Due to its fragrant and gentle nature, it also promotes mental calmness and physical comfort during hot conditions. Classical Ayurvedic physicians have long regarded Chandan Ark as a safe and elegant cooling preparation for maintaining internal balance and vitality.

Chandan Ark 
 Introduction 
 Chandan Ark is a classical Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Safed Chandan (Santalum album), commonly known as White Sandalwood. This aromatic and cooling formulation is traditionally used for managing disorders associated with aggravated Pitta Dosha, excessive body heat, urinary irritation, burning sensation, and heat-induced weakness. In Ayurveda, White Sandalwood is regarded as one of the finest natural cooling herbs. Its fragrant heartwood possesses Sheeta Virya (cold potency) and acts as a soothing agent for the urinary system, blood, heart, and mind. Chandan Ark is prepared through the process of distillation, which captures the volatile therapeutic principles of sandalwood into a gentle aqueous extract. Because this formulation contains only sandalwood as the primary ingredient, it is considered more cooling and calming than many compound distillates. It is traditionally administered during summer seasons, burning urinary disorders, chronic Pitta aggravation, and conditions associated with internal heat. 

 Ingredients 
 Main Ingredient 
 
 Safed Chandan (White Sandalwood) (Santalum album) – 2.5 seer (~2.3 kg)
 
 Fine wood powder or coarse shavings 
 
 
 Liquid Medium 
 
 Water – 20 seer (~18–19 liters) 
 

 Method of Preparation 
 The coarse powder or shavings of high-quality White Sandalwood are soaked overnight in approximately eight times water. This prolonged soaking softens the woody fibers and facilitates extraction of aromatic constituents. The following morning, the soaked mixture is transferred into a traditional Bhapka or Nadika Yantra (distillation apparatus). The preparation is then heated gently so that the volatile cooling compounds rise with steam and condense into distilled liquid. Approximately 20 bottles of aromatic distillate are collected and stored in clean glass containers. This distillation method preserves the subtle fragrance and therapeutic cooling principles of sandalwood without exposing it to excessive heat. 

 Dosage and Anupan 
 Recommended Dose 
 
 2 to 4 tola (~24 ml to 48 ml) 
 

 Administration 
 
 Given twice daily, morning and evening 
 

 Anupan (Adjunct) 
 
 Mixed with one-fourth quantity of Mishri (Rock Sugar / Sugar Candy) 
 Administered with thin milk lassi (buttermilk-like milk preparation) 
 

 Ayurvedic Properties 
 Rasa (Taste) 
 
 Tikta (Bitter) 
 Madhura (Sweet) 
 

 Guna (Qualities) 
 
 Laghu (Light) 
 Snigdha (Unctuous) 
 

 Virya (Potency) 
 
 Sheeta (Cooling) 
 

 Vipaka (Post-digestive Effect) 
 
 Madhura (Sweet) 
 

 Dosha Action 
 
 Pacifies Pitta Dosha 
 Calms aggravated Rakta (blood heat) 
 Mildly balances Vata Dosha 
 

 Therapeutic Actions 
 Chandan Ark possesses the following Ayurvedic actions: 
 
 Dahahara – relieves burning sensation 
 Mutrala – supports healthy urination 
 Raktaprasadaka – purifies and cools blood 
 Pittashamaka – pacifies aggravated Pitta 
 Hridaya – supports cardiac calmness 
 Manah Prasadana – calms the mind 
 

 Indications 
 Traditionally, Chandan Ark is beneficial in: 
 
 Burning urination 
 Heat-related urinary disorders 
 Pitta aggravation 
 Excessive thirst 
 Burning sensation in body 
 Blood heat disorders 
 Blood heat disorders 
 Mild irritability due to heat 
 General body heat and restlessness 
 
 Its cooling nature also makes it useful during hot climatic conditions and in individuals with Pitta-dominant constitution. 

 Mode of Action 
 According to Ayurvedic principles, excessive heat in the body affects the Rakta Dhatu (blood tissue), urinary tract, digestive system, and mind. Chandan Ark helps reduce this aggravated heat through its cooling and soothing properties. 

 Its mild aromatic principles act upon: 
 
 The urinary tract 
 Circulatory system 
 Nervous system 
 Digestive fire aggravated by Pitta 
 
 The formulation helps maintain fluid balance and reduces internal irritation without producing heaviness. 

 Modern Perspective 
 Santalum album contains several aromatic compounds including: 
 
 Alpha-santalol 
 Beta-santalol 
 Volatile oils 
 Sesquiterpenes 
 
 These compounds are known for: 
 
 Cooling and soothing effects 
 Mild antimicrobial activity 
 Relaxing fragrance 
 Anti-inflammatory properties 
 
 Distilled sandalwood preparations have traditionally been valued for urinary comfort, skin cooling, and emotional calmness. 

 Advantages of Ark Preparation 
 The Ark (distillate) form offers several benefits: 
 
 Rapid absorption 
 Light digestion 
 Pleasant aroma 
 Easy administration 
 Cooling effect without heaviness 
 
 Unlike dense decoctions or oily preparations, Chandan Ark is gentle on digestion and suitable even in weak digestive states. 

 Precautions 
 
 Excessive use in very cold constitution individuals should be avoided 
 Use cautiously in severe low digestive fire conditions 
 Store in a cool, airtight glass bottle 
 Always use clean and properly prepared distillate 
 

 Conclusion 
 Chandan Ark is a simple yet highly effective Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Santalum album (White Sandalwood). Its cooling, soothing, and Pitta-pacifying properties make it valuable in urinary irritation, burning sensation, excessive body heat, and blood-related Pitta disorders. Due to its fragrant and gentle nature, it also promotes mental calmness and physical comfort during hot conditions. Classical Ayurvedic physicians have long regarded Chandan Ark as a safe and elegant cooling preparation for maintaining internal balance and vitality.
